I keep meaning to write here more and then six months go by. Classic.

Anyway. We moved. The new place is smaller than the old one and the kitchen has this aggressively yellow tile that i hated for exactly two weeks and now weirdly love? It catches the morning light and the whole room goes warm and i drink my coffee there and pretend im a person who has their life together.

The move itself was a nightmare, dont let anyone tell you otherwise. We rented the truck for a Saturday, it rained, my brother bailed at the last minute (love you Tom, still mad), and i found out my couch does not fit up the new staircase the hard way. It's currently in the garage. The couch lives in the garage now. This is my life.

But the neighborhood is good. There's a bakery two blocks down that does these cardamom buns and im pretty sure thats the real reason i agreed to move. No regrets on the buns. Some regrets on the couch. We'll figure it out. We always do, eventually, usually around the time it stops mattering.
